# Template — decision record (ADR)

Append to `docs/DECISIONS.md`. Delete the guidance in brackets.

---

## D<n> — [The decision, as an imperative statement]

**Status:** `ACTIVE` | `SUPERSEDED` | `PROVISIONAL` | `RETIRED` · YYYY-MM-DD ·
[link to the enforcing invariant/test, if any]

**Context.** [What forced a choice. One or two sentences — enough that the
constraint is clear without reading code.]

**Alternatives.** [What else was genuinely on the table. If there were none,
this probably does not need an ADR.]

**Why this one.** [The reasoning. Be honest about what it optimizes for —
"reproducibility against a public dataset beats variational quality here" is a
real answer.]

**Cost accepted.** [What is worse because of this choice. Every real decision
has one. Naming it prevents someone "fixing" it later.]

**How it is enforced.** [Test, assertion, invariant, or "convention only" —
say which.]

**Revisit when.** [The condition that would reopen it, if any.]
